title: Vertex AI: Memory Banks, Agent Search, and Task Steering
summary: Vertex AI v1beta1 introduces a powerful new `MemoryBanks` resource for managing persistent agent memory, alongside new methods for searching agents and steering active tasks. This update also includes breaking changes, making several properties read-only, which may require code adjustments.
details:
Developers can now leverage the new `MemoryBanks` resource under `projects.locations.memoryBanks` to create, retrieve, list, update, and delete memory banks, as well as `retrieveScopes`. This enables more sophisticated state management for AI applications. Agent discoverability is enhanced with the new `projects.locations.agents.search` method, which supports filtering and ordering. For finer control over agent tasks, the `projects.locations.agents.tasks.steer` method allows sending follow-up inputs or triggering scheduled tasks without needing a bidirectional stream.

**Breaking Changes:** Several properties have been made read-only. If your code attempts to write to these fields, it will now fail:
*   `regionalEnableModelResponses` in `GoogleCloudAiplatformV1beta1EnableModelResponse`
*   `createTime` and `updateTime` in `GoogleCloudAiplatformV1beta1MemoryBank`
*   `enablementState` and `publisherEndpoint` in `GoogleCloudAiplatformV1beta1RegionalEnableModelResponse`

Additionally, OAuth scopes for `discoveryengine.assist.readwrite` and `discoveryengine.serving.readwrite` have been extended to more methods, deepening integration with Discovery Engine.
breaking_reasons: Property 'regionalEnableModelResponses' in schema 'GoogleCloudAiplatformV1beta1EnableModelResponse' was made read-only / immutable
Property 'createTime' in schema 'GoogleCloudAiplatformV1beta1MemoryBank' was made read-only / immutable
Property 'updateTime' in schema 'GoogleCloudAiplatformV1beta1MemoryBank' was made read-only / immutable
Property 'enablementState' in schema 'GoogleCloudAiplatformV1beta1RegionalEnableModelResponse' was made read-only / immutable
Property 'publisherEndpoint' in schema 'GoogleCloudAiplatformV1beta1RegionalEnableModelResponse' was made read-only / immutable
migration_steps: Remove any code that attempts to set the `regionalEnableModelResponses` property in `GoogleCloudAiplatformV1beta1EnableModelResponse`.
Remove any code that attempts to set the `createTime` or `updateTime` properties in `GoogleCloudAiplatformV1beta1MemoryBank`.
Remove any code that attempts to set the `enablementState` or `publisherEndpoint` properties in `GoogleCloudAiplatformV1beta1RegionalEnableModelResponse`.
